review_runs.summary: Selected source teaches the intended contrast accurately, with clear examples, answerable practice, and an independent writing task. Two minor weaknesses: delayed explanation of “modal verb” and an instructional-design label in a learner-facing heading. Reviewed all 9 exercises; each serves obj-infinitive-marker-01. Recognition, completion, sentence building, and error correction directly practice å before infinitives after non-modal expressions, omission after modal verbs, or both. Focused exercises serve relevant subskills; none relies on shared topic vocabulary alone.
